_comment: Damage reflection, design step 6 (docs/design/damage-reflection-pipeline.md 10). Two Spiteful Slivers +
four opponent Spirits = 6 creatures, so Blasphemous Act costs {2}{R} off three Mountains. Each Spiteful
Sliver grants EVERY Sliver we control its own instance of 'whenever this creature is dealt damage, it
deals that much damage to target player' (CR 113.2c: each instance triggers separately), so each of the
two Slivers reflects 13 TWICE: 2 x 2 x 13 = 52 -- exactly the opponent's life. Both Slivers die to the
same Act and still grant for that event (the trigger snapshot is taken before SBA). One instance per
Sliver (26) or none (a snapshot after SBA) leaves the opponent alive, and attacking for 4 a turn cannot
